To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the industry is a key actor in the management of the fisheries, that it is an actor that is difficult to define, that it is not a single actor but a group of different interests, and that it is a group of actors that is not necessarily united.

the participants in the Mid-Atlantic fisheries governance discourse refer to participation as a means to achieve a variety of goals, some of them contradictory, and that these goals are often expressed as a set of expectations for participation.
participants in Mid-Atlantic fishery management talk about industry participation in a variety of ways that can be organized into six broad interpretive categories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways that people talk about the participation of the industry in management.
the ways that the participants talk about their participation and the relationship of these interpretations to the legitimacy of the management process.
how participants in Mid-Atlantic fishery management refer to participation in their talk.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the participants in this case talk about industry participation in terms of the ways that it can be a source of legitimacy for the management system and the ways that it cannot.
the discourse on industry participation is not a single, unified, and unchanging discourse.
participation is a process that can have many meanings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
participation is a process of negotiation about the meaning of participation.
participation is not a simple concept.
participation is a complex, multifaceted concept.
The main takeaway from our work is that
participants in the management process have very different understandings of what “participation” means.
the participants are not talking about the same thing when they talk about participation.
the participants’ talk about “participating” in fisheries management is complex and varied.
